global.description: Platform values (global.okdp): the context's layers, the platform's (platform.yaml) then its project's (project.yaml), never an instance's.

cpu.title: CPU (vCPU)
cpu.description: CPU request in vCPU. The limit is twice the request.

memoryGi.title: Memory (GiB)
memoryGi.description: Memory request in GiB. The limit is twice the request.

db.title: Metadata database
db.description: The SQL database hosting the metastore schema: a database of its own by default ({}, a claim of the default class of database-server connections), a claim written out ({class: <class>} or {provider: <namespace>/<instance>}), or the name of a connection, of an output of another instance of the namespace, or of a named claim of the project. Its credentials Secret (secretRef) holds the keys username and password.

storage.title: Object store
storage.description: The S3 object store hosting the warehouse: the name of a connection (the platform's store, in practice), of an output of another instance of the namespace, or of a named claim of the project; or a claim the instance writes, a bucket of its own ({}, a claim of the default class of s3 connections, {class: <class>}, {provider: <namespace>/<instance>}), its identity's credentials the connection's secretRef. No claim by default.

s3SecretRef.title: S3 credentials secret
s3SecretRef.description: Secret with keys accessKey/secretKey, this metastore's own S3 identity. Empty: the storage connection's credentials Secret (secretRef), a claimed bucket's identity.

warehouseBucket.title: Warehouse bucket
warehouseBucket.description: S3 bucket used as the warehouse directory. Empty: the storage connection's bucket, a claimed bucket.

upstream.title: Upstream chart values
upstream.description: Values of the upstream chart this chart renders, merged over the values it computes: any upstream parameter can be set, except the ones the platform relies on. Maps merge, lists and scalars replace. No key or value may contain '{{'.

hive-metastore.title: hive-metastore
hive-metastore.description: Values of the hive-metastore chart 1.4.0 (oci://quay.io/okdp/charts/hive-metastore), for example image, replicaCount, resources, nodeSelector, tolerations, configOverrides, networkPolicies, s3.proxy. Refused: fullNameOverride, serviceName, servicePort, db, s3.url, s3.accessKey, s3.secretKey, cloud_storage, initJob.annotations. Appended to the list this chart sets: extraEnvRaw.

noTemplate.description: No key or string value, at any depth, contains '{{': upstream charts pass some values to tpl.
